title: Bread of life
gist: The title Jesus takes after feeding the five thousand. Moses fed Israel with manna; Jesus offers himself as bread that gives eternal life. The later part of John 6, about eating his flesh and drinking his blood, has been read in the Church from the earliest centuries as speaking of the Eucharist.

passages.note: 'The bread that I will give is my flesh.'
'This is the bread which the Lord hath given you.'
